card.name: Me, her, or after linking words
card.fires_on: Short words such as "me", "her" or "or" right after a linking word like "like", "except", "and" or "no X", in general web prose. Also a start of "me" inside words like "meanders" and "mefenamic".

modes.label: Pronoun after linker
modes.description: Object or possessive pronoun (me, her) right after like, except, and, or.
modes.example: Bad news for women who—like<< me>>—prefer black tea: The study failed

modes.label: Or after a negated noun
modes.description: The word "or" joining a second item after "no + noun".
modes.example: The main point of my little History lesson is to show that no race<< or>> ethnicity has a monopoly on being the victims

modes.label: Start of me- words
modes.description: The piece "me" opening a longer word such as meanders or mefenamic.
